definitions.explanation: Causing physical or emotional pain or discomfort.
Being in a difficult situation, especially financially.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{苦|くる}しく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{苦|くる}しくて、⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The parting was so painful that I couldn't stop crying.

notes:
{苦|くる}しい expresses pain, difficulty, or distress.

FORMS:
- {苦|くる}しい (dictionary form)
- {苦|くる}しく (adverb: painfully)
- {苦|くる}しさ (noun: pain, difficulty)
- ⟦{苦|くる}しがる→苦しがる：noentry⟧ (to show signs of pain)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{苦|くる}しい (hard to breathe)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{苦|くる}しい (life is hard financially)
- {苦|くる}しい⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ (difficult position)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {苦|くる}しい: painful, distressing
- ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧: hard, tough (emotionally)
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: painful (physical)
- ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: difficult (intellectually)
